purpose: Recognize intended Korean words spoken by children aged 3-6; calibrate expected-word acceptance separately.

consultation.provider: User-installed Claude Code CLI; explicitly requested by user
consultation.codex_final_judgment: Accept natural-first training and a later bounded sampling comparison. Preserve verified existing CTC normalization. Add an age4 non-regression gate despite Claude's suggestion to omit it.

train_long_audio_policy.action: Temporary manifest exclusion, retain original WAV and labels; do not truncate audio with unchanged text.
train_long_audio_policy.dev_test_policy: Preserve full utterances, including >20s; validate singleton inference memory before starting the run.

data.cross_dataset_identity_assumption: User explicitly assumes no child appears in both datasets; this is not verified.
data.audio_storage: Reference retained WAV paths directly, without copying or using deleted TAR offsets.
data.review_policy: Do not strip unresolved tags, relabel from model predictions, or automatically treat listening notes as training labels.

annotation_tag_exclusion.decision: User confirmed exclusion on 2026-10-27, after the Claude consultation.
annotation_tag_exclusion.action: Exclude the entire utterance; do not admit it by stripping tags or accepting listening notes.

silence_policy.decision: User explicitly chose to train as-is on 2026-10-27 and revisit if problems appear.
silence_policy.input: Full retained WAV, including leading/trailing/internal silence; no VAD, crop, denoising or concatenation.
silence_policy.annotation_metadata: 540 has utterance start/end metadata; 108 active catalogs do not. Boundary metadata does not prove the excluded interval is silent.
silence_policy.product_check: Evaluate silence/noise-only inputs separately; blank is an output omission symbol, not a dedicated silence classifier.

labels.tokenization: Existing normalized spelling -> Unicode NFD positional jamo; spaces -> boundary token.
labels.decoding: Restrict to true frame lengths, CTC collapse repeats then remove blanks, boundary to space, NFC composition. Retain malformed jamo and score as errors.

model.initialization: Original pretrained encoder with a fresh Linear(1280,69) head; head dropout0.1; seed917. No old42-head/optimizer/cursor reuse.

loss.empty_target_policy: Not part of this spelling baseline; handle silence/noise as evaluation negatives.

optimizer.weight_decay_scope: All trainable tensors, matching existing trainer

head_phase.encoder: Frozen, eval mode, no_grad, SpecAugment disabled
head_phase.if_acceptance_fails: Diagnose preprocessing/labels/CTC/optimization before joint training; no automatic warmup extension.

joint_phase.trainable: All transformer, feature projection and CTC head parameters; CNN remains frozen
joint_phase.schedule: Linear warmup, stable peak, then linear decay controlled by actual cumulative nonpadding training audio seconds
joint_phase.epoch_equivalent_definition: Cumulative joint training audio seconds on winning lineage divided by total admitted training seconds; excludes head phase and losing branch.
joint_phase.plateau_reference: Significant-best monitor CER; reset patience when current CER <= reference*(1-0.02). Record absolute best separately.
joint_phase.end_rule: Stop at decay end or 3.0equivalents, whichever first; select validation checkpoint.
joint_phase.persistent_regression: If macroCER exceeds absolute best by >=3% relative for3 consecutive evaluations, inspect the run and begin the same decay if overfitting is confirmed. No automatic checkpoint rewind.
joint_phase.invalid_loss_policy: Stop and diagnose NaN/Inf/infeasible CTC. Do not silently skip or blindly halve LR.

regularization.waveform_augmentation: None in first baseline; no gain, speed, pitch, added noise or arbitrary time crops. This is an experimental-control choice, not proof those methods harm accuracy.

bounded_resource_profile.scope: Eight timed joint updates from a 2048-record random training sample; not the final production trainer or a full memory preflight.
bounded_resource_profile.concurrency_limit: Other GPU occupancy changed between trials; do not attribute all timing differences to the offload setting.

resources.length_bucket_policy: Mix shuffled length buckets across updates; never average microbatch means. Log realized records/seconds/target tokens and repeat counts by age and dataset.
resources.precision: FP32 master weights/head/log-softmax; deterministic FP32 CPU CTC, BF16 encoder autocast, FP32 evaluation

further_batch_fallback.full_10_to_20_second_utterances: Only as preflight-validated singleton exceptions; record actual budget overages, do not truncate.

resources.evaluation_long_utterances: Full singleton inference, independently memory-tested including maximum test duration before model training; reduce eval batching if needed.
resources.preflight: Measure real training/optimizer/eval peaks with moment buffers allocated, all length buckets and concurrent processes present. Measure audio-seconds per wall second and update latency. No unsupported duration estimate or silent CPU fallback.
resources.if_all_configs_fail: Leave memory gate unresolved and report measured limitation; do not silently switch model/precision or stop unrelated processes.
resources.checkpoint_contents: Model, head, both optimizer states, phase/schedule/counters, sampler cursor/cycle, Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG, input contract hashes and software versions
resources.retention: Keep latest2 resumable states, branch fork until selection, selected full-dev candidates; establish new run directory, never delete old experiment artifacts.
resources.ctc_reason: Pinned native CUDA CTC backward is nondeterministic. FP32 CPU CTC with differentiable device copies passed bitwise next-update replay, including full optimizer state.

age_sampling.default: Natural distribution, shuffled without replacement per data pass; no downsampling of age6.

comparison.checkpoint_boundary_tolerance: At most one completed optimizer update; save immediately at first crossing.
arms: Sample age with p proportional to sqrt(admitted_record_count), then shuffled cycling within age
comparison.audio_budget_tolerance: At most one optimizer update; log exact excess
comparison.fork_state: Identical model/head/optimizer/RNG/schedule; only sampler policy differs. Preserve natural cursor; initialize balanced sampler deterministically from seed917 and fork identifier.
comparison.branch_lr: Hold peak rates after already completed joint warmup; no branch-specific decay
comparison.validation: Entire fixed dev set for each arm at equal additional actual audio exposure

sqrt_adoption_all_required.zero_reference_cer_rule: Age3 zero reference CER cannot satisfy improvement; other age with zero reference requires zero candidate CER.
sqrt_adoption_all_required.product_dev_rule_if_available: At the same frozen candidate-independent matching rule, require no false-accept regression. No product claims if labeled child positives/negatives are unavailable.

comparison.bootstrap: Report paired speaker-cluster90% interval with10000resamples,seed917; exploratory with7age3IDs, not an adoption veto or proof of population improvement.
comparison.if_no_clear_pass: Continue natural arm; retain both branch results.
comparison.skip_conditions: Preflight/resource/storage instability or persistent-regression diagnosis unresolved at fork; record exact reason and continue natural only once training is healthy.
comparison.late_risk: A short branch cannot establish freedom from late speaker overfitting. Continue per-age validation/repeat-count logging, keep natural checkpoint as final fallback.

evaluation.primary_cer: NFC output/reference, whitespace removed; edit distance divided by reference character count. Preserve malformed output symbols as errors.
evaluation.selection_score: Arithmetic mean of the four age-level corpus CER values; do not weight ages by their hours.

monitor.sampling: Fixed seeded speaker-diverse selection from dev only, round-robin speakers with mixed lengths and dataset coverage; freeze manifest before training.
monitor.endpoints: Also evaluate at head end, branch endpoints, decay end and final checkpoint; no duplicate evaluation of identical checkpoint.

evaluation.full_dev_budget: Two branch endpoints plus at most3 additional shortlisted checkpoints; reuse cached scores by model+manifest+metric hashes.
evaluation.shortlist: Monitor-best macroCER, monitor-best age3CER, and best late/decayed checkpoint, deduplicated. Include cached natural branch fallback in final eligible ranking.
evaluation.final_selection: Minimum full-dev equal-age macroCER; exact ties break by age3CER, then earlier checkpoint.
evaluation.asr_test: Once for the final selected model after decoding and model-selection policy are frozen; no further tuning on test scores.
evaluation.product_task: Separate child-word dev/test speakers with acceptable target pronunciations, confusable non-target words, silence/noise; calibrate matcher threshold on dev then freeze before product test.
evaluation.personal_recordings: Regression examples only; mostly adult/unknown age, not evidence of child acceptance accuracy.
evaluation.no_child_word_test_available: May develop ASR, but cannot report validated product acceptance/false-accept accuracy.
evaluation.legacy_model_comparison: Same spelling-CER metric on frozen dev if needed, with baseline exposure/old objective limitations stated; legacy42jamo JER is not comparable.

next_engineering_steps: Monitor head1000 gate and joint training per-age CER; diagnose explicit failure gates rather than auto-restarting.
Evaluate natural/sqrt sampling at the planned fork, select on full dev, then run final test once.
Collect child target-word positives/confusable negatives and silence/noise examples for product acceptance calibration.

evidence.public_source_limit: Public docs establish architecture/API behavior, not the optimality of this project's proposed hyperparameters. Local pinned config/code take precedence over generic examples. Retrieved public CTC documentation is2.14; the installed environment remains2.13.0+cu130 and was not upgraded.
